Anonymization policy: do NOT include real store names, revenue/financial
figures, product names/SKUs, or customer data anywhere in this issue.
Use generic placeholders instead (e.g. "Store A", "Product X", "$XXX").
Do NOT attach screenshots - describe the UI/state in text instead.

## Summary
A short, one or two sentence description of the enhancement.

## Problem / motivation
What's the current limitation or pain point this addresses?

## Proposed solution
What would you like to happen? Describe the desired behavior/feature.

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you thought about, and why they were ruled out (if applicable).

## Additional context
Any other context, anonymized examples, or references that help explain the request.
